dialogues.speaker: Contestant with Super OP Gear
dialogues.text: Hey there! I'm back! So then, how's the Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp coming along...?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: My savior! Thanks for helping out with the permit! And for the sign with the epic artwork!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Wait, I know that look... Are you, uh, looking to flip some beetle too?

dialogues.speaker: Contestant with Super OP Gear
dialogues.text: I have a big client who does a lot of cross-border commerce — anyway, she showered me with gifts once after I helped her win a huge lawsuit, and among them was a very special Onikabuto.

dialogues.speaker: Contestant with Super OP Gear
dialogues.text: I didn't know how to look after it at the time, so I got Granny to look after it for a while. It's looking pretty buff these days...

dialogues.speaker: Contestant with Super OP Gear
dialogues.text: Mind if I join in? You're not worried I'll cramp your style, are you...?

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: We ought not dismiss your savior, Oni King. What she lacks in experience, she makes up for with one of the sturdiest-built and most awe-inspiring Onikabuto I have ever seen.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You make me an offer I can't refuse...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Alright, time to send in the Oni King's Right Hand with Crimson Staff. I know my compadre will stay cool under pressure!

response.speaker: Contestant with Super OP Gear
response.text: I haven't quite got the hang of this game yet, so apologies in advance for any blunders.

choices.text: Thanks for the vote of confidence!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yanfei's Onikabuto is so strong! What has Madame Ping been feeding that thing...

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: See? Your savior's Onikabuto is a force to be reckoned with.

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: But just like last time, when my generals threw you a few curveballs, the mightiest blade cannot slay its foe except in the hands of a skilled swordmaster.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: W—W—Wise words, Grandmaster... Ooookay... Good thing my compadre kept it together!

dialogues.speaker: Contestant with Super OP Gear
dialogues.text: Wow, what a blast! I could get into this whole beetle-battling thing!

dialogues.speaker: Contestant with Super OP Gear
dialogues.text: This is so much fun! Thanks, everyone! I'm gonna stick around and play some more!
